items.text: After a general BSc pass course, the main routes are postgraduate study, skill-based private jobs, government and bank exams, teaching and education roles, and small businesses, and the best plan combines one route with a practical skill so you are not dependent on a single result.
List your subjects, pick one route and one practical skill, and check eligibility and rules before spending on courses or coaching.
Proof you can show supports an earlier path to financial freedom.
